# Tresor v0.1.1-beta.3

## Release
- Channel: beta
- Previous version: 0.1.1-beta.2
- Commit range: v0.1.1-beta.2..HEAD
- Rollout guidance: Preview release for evaluation only; expect follow-up changes before stable rollout.

## Summary
Third live beta release after skipping MSI-only Windows bundling for beta semver versions.

## Highlights
Release workflow now avoids the Tauri MSI prerelease constraint for beta tags.; Retry of the hardened private-source/public-distribution beta lane after the MSI bundling fix.

## Breaking changes
None.

## Migration hints
No migration steps required.

## Validation
- Frontend CI will re-run `npm run lint`, `npm run test`, and `npm run build` on the release tag.
- Rust CI will re-run `cargo check --workspace` and `npm run test:rust` on the release tag.
- Draft release packaging remains automatic; public publishing is a separate manual review gate.

## Commits
- fix(release): skip msi bundling for beta versions (aceae5a)
